discovery_notes: Cell B101, follow-up 1 of B023 (Asia 2017). 30 standard searches, snippets only. Adds HKDL 12th anniversary (10 named LE 500 designs), Pluto birthday, Mother's Day, Tsum Tsum glow, Chip & Dale carousel (set keyed 2018 in 422), SHDR 2017 Pin Hunting, TDR seasonal yen pins via MezzoMiki/LoveDisney. No 229 holds released (first-anniversary mystery still partial). Rule-12 holds added: teacup mystery, Abu's Bazaar game prizes, and 229 Easter Eggs Bunny, My Dreaming, Halloween names. Resellers (usshoppingsos, carousell, Yahoo flea market, vintageradar, distradingpins4u, parkscollectibles) not used.
